The Municipal Sports Board of Villanueva del Prado manages a sports center with padel and tennis courts and several rooms for directed activities. Currently, the facilities are booked by phone or at the reception of the center, during opening hours, and the bookings are written down on paper sheets.
The increase in the number of members has caused queues at reception, duplicate bookings and complaints about not being able to book outside opening hours. Therefore, the Board has decided to develop an online booking system, which is specified in this document.
